alert_name: DNS Tunneling - High Entropy Subdomain Exfiltration
mitre_technique_names: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol: Unencrypted Non-C2 Protocol
evidence: Host ENG-LAPTOP-22 (10.60.12.34) issued 412 unique high-entropy subdomain queries to tun.evil-c2.example in 5 minutes.
Subdomains average 32 characters with Shannon entropy 3.9, consistent with encoded data rather than human-readable hostnames.
All queries used TXT record type, a common DNS tunneling carrier, at a sustained rate of 88 queries/minute.
Approximately 1.84 MB of outbound DNS payload to evil-c2.example was observed in the last hour from a single host.
Suricata signature 2027870 (DNS tunneling heuristic) fired on the query stream.
